card.name: Linking words before a noun phrase
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, for, those, these, any, that and related, placed where a noun phrase about a group, condition or protected information comes next. Seen in health news and policy text.

modes.label: For after treated or tested
modes.description: The word for after a verb like treated or tested, before a condition or purpose.
modes.example: All patients being treated with antidepressants<< for>> any indication should be monitored appropriately and observed
